pull_request.body_normalized:
It turns out that the map settings manager cannot do its job correctly with the global settings hierarchy. `SL_MAP` also doesn't make sense as a global layer, normal settings are only ever read from the layer below it.
This PR allows an arbitrary hierarchy to be attached to each settings object.


fixes #11351

## To do

This PR is Ready for Review.

## How to test

1) Have a mod that runs `minetest.set_mapgen_setting("water_level", "-31000")`
2) It should not appear in minetest.conf
